column1: # Cross-number allograph clusters for Proto-Elamite signs.
# Each data line: cluster_name<TAB>code1 code2 code3 ...
# Codes listed here are counted together as one sign in frequency analyses,
# OVERRIDING the default base-number (~x/@x-stripping) grouping - and codes
# NOT listed stay with their own base number, so a cluster can pull in
# specific variants while excluding their siblings.
# Manually curated by visual comparison (Dahl 2006 sign list drawings).
# M362+X: the row-group's own template names this position as a generic
# "M362 + content sign" placeholder, not a specific grapheme - each attested
# complex grapheme below is otherwise its own distinct base number, so
# without this cluster none of them individually reaches the frequency
# needed to register as M269's head. Bare M362/M362~a/M362~b/M362~gc (no
# "+X") are NOT included - they keep their own base_number("M362") grouping,
# since it's not established every one of them fills the same head-of-row
